name: The Art of the Armorsmith
label: Quest
description: The Art of the Armorsmith: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Satisfaction. It is what I draw from the hammer and the anvil. To see a proud Horde warrior protected under my steel reminds me of what it is to be alive. It is an addiction that I dare never give up, friend.
I can not grant you this satisfaction, merely set you upon the path. As with all of life's endeavors, the path of the armorsmith is a journey.
If you wish to be one of the select few, you need only to ask and I shall train, but, a task you must first complete.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I will pound the steel until the breath itself has been taken from me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is the final step before you begin your new career as an armorsmith, friend. Should you choose to back out, now would be your last chance. Otherwise, prepare yourself for a lifetime of glory.
